kri_note: Q2 crossed the 5% KRI threshold at +6% on this product and state — a key risk indicator, and the kind of trend examiners react to.

pattern.detail: 34 dissatisfaction-language interactions this month cluster on the same product and trigger words (fee, disclosure). The surrounding data supports a genuine pattern — in an exam, the difference between a finding and a clarification.
